sources.summary: California start-up Satyress has unveiled its Threehalves robot, a teleoperated centaur-like humanoid designed to aid humans doing dangerous jobs that expose them to injury, death or extreme conditions. Threehalves was quietly unveiled on X by Satyress founder Beau Gaston last year, who said he's been working on the robot since 2022, according to an appearance The post Satyress designs centaur-like robot to give workers "superpowers" for dangerous jobs appeared first on Dezeen .
